This '''T-series tactical droid''' served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he led his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces to capture a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[information bunker]], hoping to gain valuable information about the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. However, the bunker was revealed to be a trap, and the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid's]] forces were [[Battle for the Galactic Republic information bunker|ambushed]] by Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The tactical droid fled inside the bunker, where he was cornered and destroyed by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who then took his cranial unit in order to perform a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]] to uncover the secrets it held.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Forward, forward! Put some processors into it, you scrapheaps! Must I do all the thinking here?|The tactical droid, to his troops|<ref name="Hg" />}}
[[File:Tactical_droid2.png|thumb|left|250px|The tactical droid commands his forces.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]],<ref name="Hg" /> and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> he attracted the attention of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. Wanting to obtain the data held in the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] of the tactical droid's cranial unit, Secura planned an [[Battle for the Galactic Republic information bunker|ambush]] to acquire the head of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. With her [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], she set a trap by fabricating an [[information bunker]] in a rocky canyon. Eventually, the tactical droid learned about the bunker, and, hoping to receive valuable information about the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], he led his droid forces to capture it.<ref name="Hg" />

By the time the tactical droid arrived at the bunker with his forces, Secura had hidden herself inside of it, and positioned her [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] on a nearby rock formation, where they prepared to ambush the droid forces. As a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] exploded the door of the bunker, the tactical droid ordered his [[PK-series worker droid/Legends|data retrieval droids]] to gather all of the information held in the data banks inside it. The droids, however, informed the tactical droid that the data banks were completely empty. This revelation confused the tactical droid, and at that moment, the Republic clone troopers launched their attack. Under heavy fire, the tactical droid panicked, ordering his droid forces to defend him while he fled inside the bunker and left his cohorts to be destroyed by the clone troopers. Inside the bunker, the droid stated that he was too valuable to be destroyed, but was suddenly confronted by Secura. Before the surprised droid could trigger [[cyberostasis]] to protect his memory banks, Secura quickly [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] the tactical droid with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then took the droid's unscathed head, preparing to transfer the cranial unit to her [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and analyze it with a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]].<ref name="Hg" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:AaylaDestroysTacticalDroid.png|thumb|right|180px|The tactical droid is decapitated by Aayla Secura.]]
{{Quote|I want all that's in these files!''"<br />"''Uh, sir? These data banks don't have anything in them. They're blank, sir.''"<br />"''What? Incomputable!|The tactical droid and a PK-series worker droid|<ref name="Hg" />}}
Manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="GAW" /> this droid, like all tactical droids, was 1.93 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="TCWCE" /> and was far more intelligent than standard battle droids of the Separatist Droid Army. His freedom from being controlled by a [[Central Control Computer/Legends|central control computer]] allowed him to think and function independently.<ref name="IoR">{{SW|url=video/innocents-of-ryloth-episode-featurette|text="Innocents of Ryloth" Episode Featurette}}</ref> The droid had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]] and [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].<ref name="Hg" />

The droid was very impatient and eager to gain information about his enemies. An information bunker, which the droid believed to contain Republic intelligence, proved to be too tempting a target for him to resist. He was often dissatisfied with his subordinates' activity, insulting the droids under his command while ordering them to march more swiftly and, later, to protect him. The tactical droid also believed himself to be more valuable than his troops&mdash;too much so to be destroyed. When Secura's trap was revealed, the tactical droid panicked and was not able to trigger cyberostasis in time to protect his memory.<ref name="Hg" />

==Behind the scenes==
This droid marked the debut of the tactical droids, and made his first and only appearance in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Headgames|''Headgames'']],<ref name="Hg" /> which took place before the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode "[[Jedi Crash]]" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Jedi Crash Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode013.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Jedi Crash}}</ref> ''Headgames'' was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and illustrated by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]].<ref name="Hg" />
